description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling tree-sitter parsing, including language support, query management, and symbol extraction for various programming languages.

classes.name: SymbolWithRange
classes.description: Type representing a symbol with its range and content, used for symbol extraction from parsed code.

methods.name: getParserForFile
methods.description: Initializes and returns a web-tree-sitter parser for the specified file, based on its language.

methods.name: getLanguageForFile
methods.description: Determines the web-tree-sitter language object for a given file path or URI.

methods.name: getQueryForFile
methods.description: Loads and returns a tree-sitter query object for a given file and query path.

methods.name: getSymbolsForFile
methods.description: Parses a file's contents and extracts symbols such as classes and functions with their ranges.
